name: garmin
title: Garmin
summary: Sleep, HRV, heart rate, activities and training from Garmin: your own Personal API key, or Garmin Connect's exports in a folder.

settings.help: One person from people; Garmin data is personal, never household.
3600 to 86400. Only used with a key.

settings.prompt: Time zone of the watch's days (empty: the install's)
settings.help: An IANA name such as Europe/London.
1 to 365. Later syncs read the last 7 days.

settings.prompt: Folder of Garmin Connect exports, inside the engine
settings.help: Compose mounts RHYTHM_IMPORT_DIR at /data/import, so put the files in its garmin folder.

settings.prompt: Distance unit of your exported activity lists (km or mi)
settings.help: The unit Garmin Connect shows you; the export does not say it.

secrets.prompt: Garmin Personal API key (leave empty to use exported files only)
secrets.help: Garmin Connect, Personal API Key page. Garmin shows the key once and it expires when you chose.
